title: Zoom right where you point
caption: Hold Alt and scroll to zoom toward your mouse, up to 1000%. Text stays sharp.

title: A magnifier loupe on demand
caption: Press Alt+Shift+M for a round lens that follows your mouse; Alt+scroll changes its power.

title: Alt + click to fit an image
caption: Any image, chart or video fills the window in one click, and arrow keys pan around.

title: Read the fine print
caption: Alt+Shift+scroll makes the loupe bigger or smaller. It works on text, maps, canvases and videos.

title: Simple settings, per site
caption: Turn zoom off for one site, pick the maximum zoom, and see every shortcut at a glance.

title: Move around like in Photoshop
caption: Press H, or hold Space, and drag the zoomed page. Links are never clicked by accident.
